newSource.story: See Rigi Kulm’s railway tracks, terrace and distant Alpine ridges in a refreshed still. The roof, folded parasols, wires and sunrise glare limit the view. Check the camera clock and operator notices: Kräbel–Rigi Scheidegg cable car has weekday maintenance 2–13 November 2026, and Weggis–Rigi Kaltbad 16–27 November. An active camera does not confirm trains, restaurants or trails are open; check your exact route before booking.
